references.text: Joseph's sons who were born in Egypt: Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.
All the descendants of Jacob were seventy persons; Joseph was already in Egypt.
Your fathers went down to Egypt, seventy persons in all, and now the Lord your God has made you as numerous as the stars of heaven.
Then Joseph sent word and called his father Jacob and all his relatives to him, seventy-five persons in all.
Connects the end of the journey (70 persons) with the beginning of the Egyptian period for the children of Israel.
Identical introduction to the genealogy list in the same chapter confirming who came to Egypt.
Illuminates the transition from arrival to the establishment of the 'father's house' in Egypt throughout Jacob's lifetime.
Part and whole: The specific count of Zilpah's branch (16) contributes to the total number of 70.
Defines the core family (Rachel's sons) included in the total number of 70.
